companyIntro.name: BrightPath Learning
companyIntro.mission: Design training that changes what people do at work, not just what they know.
companyIntro.culture: Start from the performance problem. Measure behaviour, not smiles.

projectBackground.name: Onboarding Academy
projectBackground.context: New hires take months to become productive. The client wants onboarding that changes performance and can prove it.

manager.name: Hannah Cole
manager.role: Head of Learning Design, BrightPath Learning
manager.note: Start with the performance problem. Then design, then measure what people do differently.

assignment.title: Design and evaluate the programme
assignment.brief: Calculate completion and ROI, write objectives, analyse assessment items in Excel and write a redesign note.

tasks.title: Completion Rate
tasks.prompt: 600 enrolled; 420 completed. What is the completion rate (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Completion is a basic engagement measure.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Training ROI
tasks.reasoning: ROI compares net benefit with cost.
tasks.mistake: Using unsupported benefit figures damages credibility.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Kirkpatrick Level 3
tasks.mistake: Satisfaction surveys alone don't show performance.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Learning Objectives
tasks.prompt: Select features of good learning objectives.
tasks.tip: Write them from the learner's view.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Item Analysis (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Pass % in column D = correct / attempts x 100.
tasks.reasoning: Q2 is the hardest; it may be unclear or poorly taught.
tasks.mistake: Assuming low scores are always learner failure ignores poor questions.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Course Redesign Note
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence course redesign note.
tasks.modelAnswer: Completion is 70% and ROI is an estimated 114%, but Question 2 has only a 55% pass rate, which suggests the content or the question is unclear. I propose rewriting the objective behind Q2 in measurable terms, adding a short practice scenario, and rewriting the question if the content is sound. We will measure on-the-job behaviour at 60 days with manager feedback. The redesign will be piloted with one cohort first.
tasks.reasoning: A good note uses data to propose changes and a way to evaluate them.
tasks.mistake: Changing everything at once hides what worked.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Happy Sheets
caseStudy.background: A course scored 4.8/5 on satisfaction but managers saw no change in performance. The programme was cancelled after a year.
caseStudy.solution: BrightPath adds baseline metrics and 60-day manager checks to every course.
